out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Hand soap was not provided at two hand sinks during the time of inspection. One located in the Main Kitchen and one located in The Garden.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT ALL HAND SINKS NEED TO HAVE HAND WASHING SOAP TO EMPLOYEES TO WASH HANDS AT ANY TIME. PIC WAS ABLE TO PROVIDE HAND SOAP PUMP BOTTLES AT TIME OF INSPECTION FOR THE HAND SINKS.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: unsalted butter sitting out on a 2DR flat top cooler in the Main Kitchen for one hour, was temping at 74F at time of inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT ALL COLD HOLDING FOODS NEED TO BE KEPT AT 41F OR BELOW. DUE TO THE BUTTER BEING UNSALTED, IT NEEDS TO BE KEPT COLD. PIC MOVED UNSALTED BUTTER TO THE WALK-IN FREEZER TO RAPIDLY COOL IN ORDER TO BE ABLE TO USE IT, SINCE THE BUTTER HAD ONLY BEEN ON THE FLAT TOP TABLE FOR 1 HOUR.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: multiple seasoning shakers and squeeze bottles around both the Main Kitchen and The Garden without a label on it, identifying what it is.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. BY TIME OF NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION, PLEASE MAKE SURE TO LABEL ALL SEASONING SHAKERS AND SQUEEZE BOTTLES AROUND BOTH THE MAIN KITCHEN AND THE GARDEN.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: No CFM present during the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT A CFM NEEDS TO BE PRESENT AT ALL TIMES OF OPERATION. PIC WAS ABLE TO PROVIDE EHS WITH THE CFM CREDENTIALS.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: No ‘Hand Wash Only’ were present at any of the hand washing sinks in the facility.
violations.corrective_action: EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT ALL HAND WASHING SINK NEED TO HAVE A ‘HAND WASH ONLY’ SIGN AT THEM BY THE TIME OF NEXT INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions.
violations.corrective_action: PIC ORDERED A PACK OF CHLORINE TEST STRIPS OFF AMAZON BEFORE THE END OF THE INSPECTION AND SHOWED EHS THE INVOICE OF PURCHASE.
